name: Hive Vitality
desc: The pulse of the fabrication strata: the hive's capacity to grow new population strata and Defense Swarms. Vitality is the product of two factors - whether the colony's fabrication organs (Fabrication Core, Swarm Nexus) are RUNNING at all, and how well-supplied its production chain is (imports through its port included). Disrupt the organs or cut the supply lines and vitality collapses; a colony held below the failure point declines, losing population until the hive itself gutters out.

name: Ground War
desc: An enemy army is on the surface. A size-S colony is S strata deep: the invaders take them one at a time, each one they hold stripping its share of the ground defenses, and if they take the last one the colony is lost - bombardment alone can never do that, from either direction. The garrison counter-attacks on a cadence paced by stability, faster where there is a military command to run it, and can win strata back. The invaders burn heavy armaments every day they stand there; an army that runs dry fights at half strength and bleeds.

name: War Footing
desc: The colony is mobilised for war against the Threat. Its garrison, yards and depots draw marines, heavy armaments, fuel and supplies beyond what its industries would otherwise want, and whatever it has above that demand is banked into a war reserve that its faction's expeditions, task forces and convoys sail on. A colony short of any of these spends that reserve on its own shortage first.
